newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH Q2 ROAD TRANSPORTS UP 14 PCT YR/YR -SF.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH Q2 ROAD TRANSPORTS UP 14 PCT YR/YR -SF.

text.p: Finnish road tranports rose 14 percent year-on-year to 87 million tonnes in the second quarter of the year, Statistics Finland said in a statement on Tuesday.
Measured as tonne kilometres, growth was 17 percent, it said but did not give the absolute data.

Of the 87 million transported on Finnish roads in Q2 1997, 40 percent was gravel and other land material. The second largest sector was timber and pulpwood, which accounted for 13 percent of road transports, SF said.
Transport capacity increased clearly from the year ago period, with the number of registered lorries up 2,200 to 47,800, SF said.
